generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original common-appearance agricultural covering-material illustration for an adult learning app. Subject: one unbranded black thin flexible agricultural film sheet, displayed loosely over a small plain brown soil patch. Show the complete simple sheet with a gently folded-back corner and a slightly lifted edge so its flexible sheet appearance and soft irregular creases are visible. Both visible sides remain black or charcoal, not a white laminated underside. The surface is smooth continuous film, not woven fabric, knitted net, rigid panel or thick rubber mat. Composition: independent shallow three-quarter view, mostly horizontal sheet with an irregular relaxed edge, entirely inside generous margins, isolated on a uniform warm ivory background. Gentle restrained botanical/educational 2D painted illustration, subtle soft highlights and natural folds, consistent with calm agricultural crop illustrations. No plants, planting holes, crops, hands, tools, stakes, exact spacing, dimensions, instructions, printed material markings, resin symbols, labels, arrows, text, numbers, logos, border or watermark. No reference images supplied; do not copy a textbook photograph or page composition. This is an example of visible sheet appearance only. Do not imply that black appearance proves polyethylene rather than PVC, that all agricultural polyethylene film is black, or any specific thickness, UV resistance, temperature or performance.
